archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) + Swiss Precision for Data
design_philosophy: A deeply moody, tactical, and ultra-legible finance tracker. High contrast for numbers, subtle structural borders, and highly intentional use of color indicating financial health. Avoids generic fintech purple/teal gradients. Relies on pure blacks, grays, and specific semantic colors.

kpi_card.layout: Column with top-left label (micro) and bottom-left large value (h2).

bottom_tab_bar.blur: Yes (if supported by Expo BlurView, otherwise solid #0A0A0C)

Dashboard.layout: Top: Total Combined Limit & Balance Today (h1_balance). Middle: Financial Pie Chart using specific colors. Bottom: Horizontal scroll of KPI Cards (MSI Debt, Positive/Negative Projections).
Dashboard.spacing: Heavy use of p_lg spacing between vertical sections.

Tarjetas.layout: Vertical list of 'bank_card_visual' items. Floating Action Button (FAB) bottom right (+) to add new card. Each card shows: Alias, Bank, Limit, Cut Date, Pay Date.
Tarjetas.currency_support: MXN, USD, EUR badges top right of card.

MSI.layout: List of active MSIs. Each item shows purchase name, total amount, and 'msi_progress_bar'. Grouped by card.

Movimientos.layout: Segmented Control (Ingresos / Gastos). Fast access horizontal ScrollView for 'expense_quick_chip' (Comida, Servicios, Amazon/E-commerce, Transporte, Entretenimiento, Salud, +). Below: Vertical list of recent transactions.

Alertas.layout: List of upcoming payments. Each item has a title (e.g. 'Faltan 3 días para corte'), amount, and a 'Pago Realizado' Switch to dismiss the alert cycle.

iconography.rules: No emojis. Sharp, stroke-based icons. 24px default size.

testing.conventions: Use testID in React Native instead of data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo project. DO NOT use HTML elements (div, span). Use View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity.
All components must be configured for mobile touch (minimum touch target 44px).
For the Pie Chart, use a library like react-native-svg-charts, victory-native, or expo-chart-kit. Ensure exact colors specified in pie_chart are passed.
Do not implement generic Vercel/Stripe styles. Stick to the dark tactical theme: #0A0A0C backgrounds, 1px white/10 borders.
For currency formatting, use Intl.NumberFormat('es-MX', {style: 'currency', currency: 'MXN/USD/EUR'}).
Use expo-sqlite for data storage and expo-notifications for the alert cycles.
Ensure 'testID' attributes are applied to every interactive element and data container for testing.
